Flo includes these open-source libraries, unmodified:

- WebLLM (@mlc-ai/web-llm) v0.2.85 — runs AI models in the browser with WebGPU.
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm
  File: web-llm.js

- PDF.js (pdfjs-dist, legacy build) v4.10.38 — reads text from PDF files in the browser.
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
  Files: pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js

- Tesseract.js v6.0.1 and tesseract.js-core v6.1.2 — text recognition (OCR) for photos and scanned pages.
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
  Files: ocr/tesseract.esm.min.js, ocr/worker.min.js, ocr/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js, ocr/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js

- Tesseract English language data (tessdata_fast, eng.traineddata).
  Licence: Apache License 2.0 — https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
  File: ocr/eng.traineddata

AI models (downloaded by the learner's browser only if they turn on Smart mode) come from
the MLC-AI project on Hugging Face and keep their own licences:
- Llama 3.2 1B and 3B Instruct ("Light" and "Best") — Llama 3.2 Community License (Meta)
- Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct ("Standard") — Apache License 2.0 (Alibaba Cloud)
